name: Fine coursed outer city wall
shape: Long continuous gray stone band; courses of small flat rectangular blocks; offsets at wall joints.
surface: Gray-beige masonry with dark mortar, sporadic chipped corners and streaks.
detailing: Modular straight, 45-degree corner, 90-degree corner and curved sections; no obvious perfect repeating texture.

name: Large irregular boulder foundation
shape: Bottom 1/3-1/2 of fortification built from big rounded polygon stones with irregular interlocking joints.
surface: Broader light gray stones, dark crevices, dusty near ground.
detailing: Use 8-15 stone silhouettes per 4m panel, varied rotation and no uniform cobblestone grid.

name: Upper parapet and crenels
shape: Flat wall-walk with raised outer protective lip and regular short block projections.
surface: Same fine masonry; chipped raised outer edges, dirt in foot zones.
detailing: Build walkable top, crenel repeat module, 2-4 variants.

name: Main arched gate opening
shape: Tall round-headed opening with visibly larger radial stones and recessed dark tunnel.
surface: Pale keystone arch, old brown interior shadows, coarse stone sidewalls.
detailing: Build actual tunnel walls/ceiling for 360-degree camera; radial voussoirs need geometry.

name: Gate-top watch terrace
suggested_size_m: 12-17 wide x 8 deep x 3 high above gate
shape: Rectangular raised bastion over gate; dense small masonry and repeated tiny square openings.
surface: Dirty gray dressed stone, recesses very dark.
detailing: Corner caps, wall walk and visible floor slabs; square vent/arrow slit modules.

name: Narrow guard openings in wall
shape: Tiny repeated black rectangle/square holes on gate tower facade.
surface: Strong black AO/recess; pale beveled stone border.
detailing: Model at least inset dark geometry on near hero wall, decal on distant repeats.

name: Ascending wall ramp / stepped terrace
suggested_size_m: ramp width 2.5-4; elevation tailored to slopes
shape: Wall changes elevation toward right upper ramparts, with terraces and a long walkway.
surface: Gray stone paving and retaining faces; irregular rock foundation.
detailing: Keep pathway traversable; adapt endpoints to wall segment heights.

name: Stone stairs and retaining plinths
shape: Several gray stone steps elevate an open timber workshop from surrounding dirt.
surface: Worn step centers with darker edge dirt.
detailing: Use 4-7 step groups; plasterless stacked stone side walls.

name: Stream culvert beneath wall
shape: Low curved masonry opening where narrow stream emerges under defensive wall.
surface: Deep dark wet recess at opening, waterline staining and slimy stones.
detailing: Water and opening must be continuous through wall, not a false dark plane.

name: Broad main dirt road
shape: Wide tan earth roadway, irregularly tapered, subtle worn center and sporadic paving pieces.
surface: Warm ochre packed soil, fine granules, small pebbles and muted traffic ruts.
detailing: Spline-based path, blend edges 1-2m into grass; preserve readable navigation.

name: Inner village street
shape: Village road funnels from near center toward distant temple buildings, widening at nodes.
surface: Sunlit beige dirt, slight wheel/foot trails, irregular blotchy dryness.
detailing: Spline network links houses, market and plaza.

name: Stepping-stone street margins
shape: Loose individual gray slabs form intermittent bordering lines along foreground cottage paths.
surface: Dusty flat stone, corners mostly rounded, varied spacing and rotation.
detailing: Place as scatter with exclusions around doorways; avoid perfect evenly spaced bricks.

name: Bare farmyard courtyard
shape: Mostly open level dirt with wheel-worn patches and very sparse grass.
surface: Broad warm pale ochre soil and random pale scuffs.
detailing: Keep center uncluttered; use vertex paint and shallow cracks, tiny stone decals.

name: Grass field patch
shape: Mottled green grass forms irregular islands near fences and house perimeters.
surface: Cool-to-warm green variations, sparse brown soil holes and short blades.
detailing: Terrain splatmap plus instanced short tuft meshes and flower specks.

name: Dirt-grass transition edge
shape: Uneven feathered boundary from compacted road to patchy lawn.
surface: Brown-green gradient; small pebbles and tufts invade road edge.
detailing: No hard painted polygon border; randomized masks and decals.

name: Rocky terrain berm and woodland soil
shape: Shallow undulating wooded banks and soil cut around rocky outcrops.
surface: Dirt, embedded gray stone, grass tufts, sparse moss.
detailing: Blend cliff/rock to soft ground with pebbles and dirt skirts.

name: Fenced small vegetable plot
shape: Tiny crop beds and flowering garden along foreground fence.
surface: Dark fertile soil, green sprawling leaves and small warm orange produce.
detailing: Raised soil strips, individual stems and fruits; crop species approximate due small image scale.

name: Gravel and road scuff decals
shape: Small stones and short irregular scrapes break flat road color.
surface: Gray-beige tiny gravel, transparent dust overlay.
detailing: Reuse 10-20 decal/gravel silhouettes and random yaw.

name: Large long thatched farmhouse
shape: Long rectangular timber house, enormous slightly barrel/hip-shaped thick straw roof, exposed dark wall framing and narrow deck.
surface: Golden straw, aged brown beams, dusty low plaster panels.
detailing: Huge overhang .6-1.2m, roof bundle ribbing, occasional loose fraying fringe, stone stepping line.

name: Front-right long thatched lodge
shape: Second long thatch structure, similar family, slanted toward view, fenced around perimeter.
surface: Bright sunny straw top, deep shadow under eaves, brown timber panels.
detailing: Must be related kit to B01, vary roof sag, porch and openings.

name: Tiny steep-hip straw shelter
shape: Small hut with sharply pitched golden thatch roof directly outside wall.
surface: Deep dark doorway, exposed straw tips, pale brown wood.
detailing: Steeper pyramid/rounded hipped silhouette; door and low sill.

name: Rustic straw barn behind wall
shape: Modest timber building under simple tan roof embedded among shrubs behind wall.
surface: Medium golden straw, brown rough frame.
detailing: Alternate gable/hip variants, irregular walls.

name: Traditional blue-roof timber house
shape: One or two-storey timber house with multi-sloped dark blue ceramic roof and slightly lifted roof-tip corners.
surface: Navy blue curved tiles, dark reddish-brown posts, beige wall infill.
detailing: Separate porch, pillars, shutters, base platform and eave brackets.

name: Main open gate pavilion
suggested_size_m: 11-15 wide x 6-9 deep x 6-8 above terrace
shape: Open pavilion atop gate bastion, broad four-sided dark tiled roof and six-plus narrow red-brown columns.
surface: Deep blue tile ribs, decorative teal eave painting, ornate corner upturns.
detailing: Exposed painted rafters, ridge caps, finials, multi-row tile pattern and banners at entry.

name: Small roofed parapet pavilion
shape: Open air lookout pavilion on higher wall section at right center.
surface: Dark navy hipped roof, brown wood posts, gray stone terrace.
detailing: Use same roof/post/bracket construction system as B06, smaller footprint.

name: Raised wood workshop / terrace house
shape: Raised wooden structure to far right with stacked timber framing, broad brown roof and repeated raised structural ribs.
surface: Warm rusty brown, worn overlapping roof boards, dark open bays.
detailing: Keep elevated gray stepped base, open lower gallery, wooden railings and ribbed top roof profile.

name: Small wooden market / storage shed
shape: Short low-stature covered stall near gate and workshop.
surface: Straw-colored shade and aged timber supports.
detailing: Open sides, sacks/crates and attached rails.

name: Interior shop-houses and balconies
shape: Dense mixed single and two-storey timber buildings with varied brown, tiled and straw roof outlines.
surface: Dark timber, cream plaster, dark clay tile, dirt patina.
detailing: Assemble from 3-5 wall modules and 4 roofs, stagger facades, varied porch and awnings.

name: Far central civic or temple buildings
shape: Layered civic palace-like buildings and a far axial gateway creating central skyline focus.
surface: Cool blue roofs, muted cream-red walls, distant haze.
detailing: Silhouette first, detail only at near LOD; no exact structure recoverable at this resolution.

name: Multi-tier hilltop pagoda
shape: Distinct tall narrow multi-tier pagoda rising from right mountain crown.
surface: Dark blue/black upturned tile floors and dark red-brown timber.
detailing: Each roof overhangs level below; accentuate tiered skyline and sit on uneven rock plateau.

name: Blue ceramic roof tile module
shape: Small concave or convex interlocked longitudinal tiles; parallel striped ribs descend each slope.
surface: Light edges dusty blue gray, recesses navy black.
detailing: Use repeated tile row geometry on near roofs, baked normals in far LODs.

name: Blue hip roof with curled eaves
shape: Broad sweeping hipped roof; corners project up and out; visible decorative line beneath eave.
surface: Shadow beneath edge nearly black; slate blue glazed tiles on upper surfaces.
detailing: Build roof as mesh surfaces or Bezier/spline lattice; roof ends must curl independently.

name: Long rounded thatch roof module
shape: Thick golden folded roof, curved long crest and giant hanging straw fringe at eave.
surface: Sunlit pale golden ridges, warm chestnut weathered grooves.
detailing: Layer base volume + clump cards + edge hair-like clumps; distinct 2D strand strokes.

name: Small conical / four-sided straw cap
shape: Tight steep roof with radial thatching and short rounded eaves.
surface: Golden cap with dark interior underside.
detailing: Fast low-poly geometry, extra strands around edge for silhouette.

name: Blue ridge ornament and end cap
shape: Long raised main ridge with dark cap tiles, curved tip-end flourishes.
surface: Tile blue with chipped gray lighter rims.
detailing: Separate topper, finial, corner ornaments to add variety without a new roof mesh.

name: Painted bracket / eave timber details
shape: Interlocking timber brackets and rafter ends colored dark red, teal and soft cream.
surface: Dark under-eave AO plus thin accent decorative paint.
detailing: Use repeated beam prefabs with 3 paint pattern variants; bright trim stays narrow.

name: Small cloth market canopy
shape: Small white/pale cream fabric canopy with colorful red fabrics around festival or stalls.
surface: Cream cloth, red accent trim; slightly uneven taut fabric.
detailing: Simple cloth folds, hanging edge, ropes and wooden posts.

name: Large green deciduous tree
shape: Brown trunk with 3-6 main forks carrying irregular rounded overlapping leaf crowns.
surface: Dark olive inner foliage, bright medium green flecks catching sun.
detailing: Avoid single perfect sphere; compose 8-20 leaf clump volumes, trunk twist and exposed gaps.

name: Medium light-green tree
shape: Narrower upright canopy, brighter olive green; many along wall outside gate.
surface: Leaf color fades lighter in sun, dark green core.
detailing: Asymmetric lobes and crown lean; make 6 seed variations and randomized size.

name: Sculptural evergreen / pine
shape: Dark evergreen separated horizontal layered crowns with sculptural bent branch silhouettes.
surface: Deep forest blue-green, less saturated than broadleaf.
detailing: Tiered flattened foliage pads, exposed branch elbows; avoid Christmas-tree cone.

name: Yellow autumn ornamental tree
shape: One highly visible yellow-gold broadleaf crown on left-upper edge of village.
surface: Ochre foliage shifting yellow sun edges, rich rust shadows.
detailing: Use V01 branching with separate autumn leaf kit; few dropped leaf decals.

name: Pink spring blossom tree
shape: Distinct pale rose-pink flowering tree near foreground stream/garden.
surface: Dense pale pink clusters over darker twig core.
detailing: Clusters on irregular branches, scatter some petals near base.

name: Small bush and hedge clusters
shape: Irregular mounded green shrubs along road, rocks and fences.
surface: Dark core, olive-highlight outer leaves, mixed sizes.
detailing: 4-8 lobes per bush, 12 variants including clipped and wild shapes.

name: Ground grass blade clumps
shape: Tufts stick out from green turf, lightly sparse on roads.
surface: Multiple olive / fresh-green blades plus dried tawny ends.
detailing: Use cross cards in distant LOD and true small tapered clumps near camera.

name: Wild flowers and tiny light flecks
shape: Very small yellow/white flower heads sprinkled amid grasses, especially garden/fence margins.
surface: Warm pale cream flower heads with green stalks.
detailing: Minimal scatter 1-4 flowers per patch, never uniform checkerboard.

name: Vines and creeping leafy plants
shape: Low broad leaves climb/stay close to garden soil, with a few trailing tendrils.
surface: Saturated green against brown-black garden dirt.
detailing: Asymmetric vine mesh and squash-like big leaves; cultivar not identifiable.

name: Forest middle-distance tree mass
shape: Multiple compact green crowns produce canopy continuum between roofs and foothills.
surface: Lower contrast olive-green clusters, softened by distance haze.
detailing: Hybrid near true meshes / distant imposter LOD for budget.

name: Patchy moss at stones and wet bank
shape: Dark green moss appears on wet stone contacts, shaded rock/ground corners.
surface: Low rough velvety dark-green layers.
detailing: Decal only near moisture; do not uniformly paint every stone.

name: Agricultural vegetable crop clumps
shape: Clustered broad leaves, twining low plants and a few yellow/orange harvest objects.
surface: Bright green leaves and tan/orange fruit accents.
detailing: Use distinct leaf, stem, fruit instanced components; exact produce uncertain.

name: Huge rounded stacked mountain cluster
shape: Tall mountain assembled from vertical broad rounded rock monoliths; a soft rocky silhouette with notched summits.
surface: Warm gray sunlit planar lobes, deep cool crevices, vegetation on ledges.
detailing: Create three layers: base mass, big lobes and scree stones, then trees; avoid razor-sharp triangles.

name: Far blue-gray mountain chain
shape: Multiple lower and higher peaks layered behind central town.
surface: Cool low-saturation rock blue-gray and fading haze.
detailing: Several background depth bands, each with distinct silhouette; lower detail LOD.

name: Right cliff temple hill
shape: Tall boulder pile under remote pagoda with many sheer rounded vertical splits.
surface: Rock in gray-beige sunlight, deep crevices and patchy small trees.
detailing: Reserve flat summit pad and paths/ledges for pagoda; scatter plants only on pockets.

name: Village boulder / rock outcrop
shape: Small to medium smoothly broken boulders placed by water, walls and houses.
surface: Mottled gray/brown faces with dark inner fissures, rare moss.
detailing: 15-plus reusable silhouettes, 30-100% buried in soil.

name: Stream stone and pebble scatter
shape: Mixed small round/flat stones border stream and sit at bends.
surface: Wet darker gray where submerged, dusty gray-beige upland.
detailing: Stones oriented with stream; use pebbles at water turbulence points.

name: Narrow winding stream
shape: Narrow continuous blue-gray channel flowing down from wall culvert toward lower screen.
surface: Water surface moderately reflective with bright white turbulent streaks.
detailing: Carve meandering bank into terrain; use water ribbon spline and depth opacity.

name: White turbulence at stream bends
shape: Thin foam filaments and broken pale streaks tracing rocks, bends and constrictions.
surface: Near-white specular flecks, pale cool-gray foam.
detailing: Flow map follows stream tangent; low foam density in calm portions.

name: Stream bank wet-soil transition
shape: Uneven muddy slopes with rock and rough grass from dry soil into water.
surface: Dark wet brown at waterline, greener on higher bank.
detailing: Gradient vertex colors; embedded pebbles; creek depth must read at top-down camera.

name: Culvert shadowed water patch
shape: Dark water emerges from a shaded shallow wall tunnel.
surface: Bluish-black water with strong lip shadow and lightening downstream.
detailing: Use light occlusion and darker underwater bed, not absolute black.

name: Tall red vertical town pennant
shape: Narrow rectangular red banners hang off upright sticks; dark circular / stamped marks.
surface: Weathered brick-red cloth with almost black emblem and slight wrinkles.
detailing: 2-3 pattern variants, bend cloth asymmetrically.

name: Simple horizontal split-rail fence
shape: Short wooden stakes with two low horizontal beams; encloses garden and roadside houses.
surface: Golden brown worn wood with dark joining pegs.
detailing: Straight, corner, end, gate, broken variant; uneven posts.

name: Woven low reed fence
shape: Thin woven reed/repeated stick fencing around thatched houses and garden.
surface: Pale ochre bamboo-like strips, dark lashings.
detailing: Use mesh with geometry+alpha only for far LOD, avoid alpha overdraw near camera.

name: Clay jars and water pots
shape: Rounded reddish clay jars, some with wide open mouths and dark interior.
surface: Terracotta red-brown, spots of glazed shine and grime.
detailing: 4 silhouette variants: fat amphora-like, squat bowl, wide jar, tall jar.

name: Crates and lumber boxes
shape: Small rectangular weathered wooden crates or storage boxes next to fences and workshops.
surface: Mid brown boards, black joints and pale chipped edges.
detailing: Reusable box mesh with rotated plank textures and open-top option.

name: Grain / straw bundle bales
shape: Pale straw bunches scattered near huts and workshops.
surface: Dry golden straw with warm-brown gaps and tied cord.
detailing: Bales with messy silhouette and ropes, several rotations.

name: Wooden benches and tables
shape: Simple rough slat benches and narrow rectangular tables along roads and within workshops.
surface: Aged brown wood with sunlit scraped surfaces.
detailing: Low cross braces and uneven seat plank thickness.

name: Logs and stacked planks
shape: Sawed timbers, timber piles and long plank stacks near far-right workshop.
surface: Warm raw brown wood, visible end grain.
detailing: 3 log diameters, 5 plank lengths, surface roughness and endcaps.

name: Small two-wheeled wooden handcart
shape: Simple handcarts and transport objects around village labor areas.
surface: Medium wood wheels/handles, dusty iron-gray hubs.
detailing: Only interpret generic cart geometry; exact vehicle partly obscured.

name: Wooden wayside sign
shape: Small dark roadside board and thin vertical support visible outside workshop zone.
surface: Dark wooden board with cool blue-black face.
detailing: 1-2 board widths and blackened calligraphy decals if legible reference available.

name: Standing lamp / hanging lantern pole
shape: Thin lantern posts with small warm orange-red hanging lights near streets and buildings.
surface: Dark timber/iron shaft and warm orange cloth lantern accent.
detailing: At noon no emissive bloom is necessary; lantern mostly reads as physical object.

name: Marketplace fabric and ribbon
shape: White stall shade plus compact strips of colored cloth around village plaza.
surface: White cream, vermilion and multiple faint festive accents.
detailing: Two-sided cloth mesh and simple wrinkle normal.

name: Decorative garden planter
shape: Small wooden or stone-bordered planted boxes with flowers and vegetable leaves.
surface: Muted beige wood or stone edge with green growth.
detailing: Use modular border tiles and instanced plant clusters.

name: Wooden support brace and ladder
shape: Visible diagonal braces under open pavilions and workshop railings; short climbing supports.
surface: Dark timber with highlighted angular edges.
detailing: Build corner diagonals separately; no need every joint unique.

name: Guard / traveler scale figures
shape: Small stylized humans on road at gate and right foreground, helpful for evaluating building sizes.
surface: Tiny contrasting dark/colored outfits.
detailing: For environment reference only: stand-in capsules acceptable for blockout.

name: Loose flowers, fallen leaves and stones
shape: Sparse small debris localized to roads, tree roots, fences and gardens.
surface: Tan dirt, dark greens, pale blossoms, grays.
detailing: Use distance culling and scattering masks rather than manual placing every grain.

name: Layered cloud sky
shape: Soft blue daytime sky with broken diffuse white cloud clusters.
surface: Blue cyan sky top, near-white broken clouds, little saturation in distant haze.
detailing: Use procedural sky, soft cloud layers and low contrast near horizon.

name: Far rooftops and miniature hamlet cluster
shape: Dense tiny blue roof silhouettes interspersed with trees across mid/far valley.
surface: Desaturated blue-gray tile roofs and warm hazy walls.
detailing: Use low LOD prefabs instanced along valley; keep varying heights.

name: Layered atmospheric depth treatment
shape: Near houses sharply defined, far valley softer, far mountains cooler and less contrasty.
surface: Blue-grey airy haze; sky-colored shadow lift.
detailing: Distance values are prototype-specific; adjust to preserve silhouette readability.
